gates: htp-pi#1 remains open; no adapter or installable package is implemented in Wave 0.
HTP OAuth sign-in from Pi is unverified in Wave 0.
seosmith#18 operation adapter is not implemented.
Backend-gated operations (htp#10, htp#6/#8/#9/#20, htp#7, htp#1, seosmith#13, seosmith#16/htp#13) activate only after their upstream issues ship.

readiness.htp: requires live host OAuth/read smoke test
readiness.seosmith: adapter gated; no host operations shipped

limitations: Legacy SSE MCP transport is rejected; streamable HTTP (usually /mcp) only.
MCP OAuth sign-in opens a browser; headless/SSH requires pasting the redirect URL.
Client identity is a Client ID Metadata Document or dynamic registration, depending on the authorization server.
Shell-level `pi mcp` commands do not load extensions.
Tokens are stored in ~/.pi/agent/mcp-auth.json, never in the package.
Project .pi/mcp.json is read only in trusted projects.

distribution.rollback: pi remove git:github.com/hatchertechnology/htp-pi, then install a pinned ref. No installable package ships in Wave 0, so this is a documented path, not a current capability.

provenance.note: Pinned local package docs are authoritative; the declared GitHub repo earendil-works/pi may be private (doc URLs 404).
